meta.title: Improve `in` parameter modifier example with meaningful struct-based demonstration
meta.body_summary: Replace C# documentation example for `in` parameter modifier from an ineffective `int` case to a struct-based example that illustrates performance benefit of passing by reference to avoid large struct copies.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot updated C# docs example for `in` modifier from int to struct to better demonstrate performance benefits; merged after approvals despite repeated Copilot work failures.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 39 changed lines in a single file, this is a very small edit by absolute volume, typical for a documentation snippet update. It was merged after two approvals, consistent with the low-risk nature of the change.

review_details.concern_detail: No concerns raised; two approvals with minimal review text.
review_details.performance_claim: The new struct-based example demonstrates performance benefits of the `in` modifier by avoiding large struct copies while preserving immutability.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot experienced repeated work start failures (`copilot_work_finished_failure`) and required multiple maintainer prompts to complete the change. Once the code was pushed, it was approved without changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: BillWagner manually reviewed the code example and approved it.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmark or reproduction steps; the PR is a documentation example improvement, not a runtime optimization.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression occurred; the PR was merged without issues.

core_change_summary.description: In RefParameterModifier.cs, replaced an insufficient `in` parameter example using `int` with a comprehensive struct-based example (`LargeStruct`) that demonstrates the performance benefit of passing by reference to avoid copying and the immutability guarantee.
change_trajectory: Implementation commit replacing the example with struct-based demonstration.

review_signals.summary: Reviewer BillWagner approved the change, noting it is ready for final review.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial plan commit.
Maintainer BillWagner requested Copilot to start working multiple times due to `copilot_work_finished_failure` events.
After multiple retries, Copilot committed the improved example.
BillWagner marked the PR ready for review and approved.
